description: This source file defines a class `StreamInterceptionGrain` which is an Orleans grain that subscribes to a stream, tracks stream values, and implements an interception filter for incoming calls.

classes.name: StreamInterceptionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain that subscribes to a stream and intercepts incoming method calls, modifying internal state based on stream activity.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Initializes stream subscription when the grain activates.

methods.name: GetLastStreamValue
methods.description: Returns the last received stream value.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Intercepts incoming grain calls, checking if stream values have changed and modifying the internal state accordingly.
